exposure: Women who delivered via Cesarean section
Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs Vaginal delivery)
outcome: Deep abdominal muscle thickness during abdominal drawing-in maneuver (ADIM)
cohort: 20 postpartum women (10 vaginal births, 10 Cesarean births) who gave birth within the past 12 months.
finding: There was no significant difference in the percentage change of deep abdominal muscle thickness during ADIM between women who delivered vaginally and those who delivered via Cesarean section.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery does not appear to further decrease abdominal muscle performance compared to vaginal delivery.
